label: S7_04_CargaFin
code_lines: T2.C_SI_SCN_N1,T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, SUM(T1.DATO)/1000 FORMAT COMMA14. AS DATO,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN 'H' ELSE 'D' END) AS C_ENTRADA,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN 'Intereses pagados' ELSE 'Intereses percibidos' END) AS ID
where T1.C_Cuenta=('YG')  AND T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_SCN IN('D.41') AND T1.FUENTE<>'DI_Aj_SIFMI'
where T1.C_Cuenta IN ('Bce Final','Bce Inicio')  AND T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_SCN IN('AF.29','AF.31','AF.32','AF.321','AF.41','AF.42')
/*CREA BASE CON INFO DE BALANCES PROMEDIO*/
FROM WORK.INT T1, WORK.SALDOS_AVG T2 WHERE T1.PERIODO=T2.PERIODO AND T1.C_SI_SCN_N1=T2.C_SI_SCN_N1 AND
sum(CASE WHEN T1.ID='Intereses pagados' THEN t1.dato*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) FORMAT COMMA14.1 AS DATO
CREATE TABLE WORK.CARGA_FIN AS SELECT * FROM WORK.CARGA_FIN_ OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM WORK.SFIN;QUIT;
DATA=WORK.CARGA_FIN (WHERE=(ID='Intereses pagados' AND C_SI_SCN_N1 NOT IN ('S.13','S.2') ) KEEP=PERIODO C_SI_SCN_N1 N_SI_SCN_N1 ID DATO )
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt /*VALUE=NONE*/ LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CI=BLACK CV = _STYLE_;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt FONT=MARKER VALUE=NONE LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CI=BLUE CV = _STYLE_;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt FONT=MARKER VALUE=NONE LINE=20 WIDTH=2 CI=RED CV = _STYLE_;
Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (BOTTOM CENTER OUTSIDE) MODE=PROTECT LABEL=NONE;
PLOT DATO * PERIODO=N_SI_SCN_N1/VAXIS=AXIS1 HAXIS=AXIS2 FRAME	LEGEND=LEGEND2;
DATA=WORK.CARGA_FIN (WHERE=(ID='Intereses percibidos' AND C_SI_SCN_N1 NOT IN ('S.13','S.2') ) KEEP=PERIODO C_SI_SCN_N1 N_SI_SCN_N1 ID DATO )
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt VALUE=NONE LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CI=BLACK CV = _STYLE_;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt FONT=MARKER VALUE=NONE LINE=1 WIDTH=4 CI=BLUE CV = _STYLE_;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt FONT=MARKER VALUE=NONE LINE=20 WIDTH=2 CI=RED CV = _STYLE_;
Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (BOTTOM CENTER OUTSIDE) MODE=PROTECT LABEL=NONE;
PLOT DATO * PERIODO=N_SI_SCN_N1/VAXIS=AXIS1 HAXIS=AXIS2 FRAME	LEGEND=LEGEND2;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt VALUE=NONE LINE=1 WIDTH=4 CI=BLACK CV = _STYLE_;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt FONT=MARKER VALUE=NONE LINE=1 WIDTH=4 CI=BLUE CV = _STYLE_;
INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt FONT=MARKER VALUE=NONE LINE=20 WIDTH=4 CI=RED CV = _STYLE_;
Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (BOTTOM CENTER OUTSIDE) MODE=PROTECT LABEL=NONE;
PLOT DATO * PERIODO=ID/VAXIS=AXIS1 HAXIS=AXIS2 FRAME	LEGEND=LEGEND2;
